catering quote from Saffron Bites just came in

main spread on the 15th: they are offering two tiers

Tier A at $48 per head includes seared tuna canapes, braised short rib station, full dessert display

Tier B at $37 per head swaps short rib for mushroom Wellington station, cuts dessert display to chocolate torte and berry pavlovas

my read: we need to stick with Tier A for the primary sponsor dinner in the Veridian Room, but we could potentially use Tier B for the general attendee reception in the Atrium if the budget gets squeezed

however, minimum for any single service is 70 guests

if our final headcount for the Veridian Room is under 70, we will need to pad it with organizing committee members to hit the minimum

we promised them the full experience

^only move people to the Atrium list if absolutely necessary

^if the count is between 70 and 90, Tier B is approved

^if it exceeds 90, switch back to Tier A for them as well, as the per-head cost difference shrinks with volume and the upgrade is worth it for the larger crowd

timing: they need final menu selection and guaranteed guest numbers by 5 p.m. this Thursday, the 7th

they offered a 3% discount if we wire the 50% deposit by Friday at noon instead of the following Monday

remaining balance due on the 13th

^confirm wire details with Aris Finance and use vendor code `CAT-882`

^note the discount explicitly in the payment authorization if the discount applies

^double-check that the proposal includes late-night snack delivery for the tech crew at 11 p.m. as a separate order of 15 boxed meals, not part of the per-head calculation

^if we go with Tier B anywhere, you must get written confirmation from Saffron Bites that all nut-based ingredients are excluded from the mushroom Wellington filling

last year's incident with pine nut puree cannot be repeated: the standard recipe includes it, so it requires a specific amendment
